RecipeDef.label: refine biomass
RecipeDef.description: Consume 45 raw biomass from adjacent hoppers and 1 neutroamine to produce exactly 10 refined biomass on success. Failure loses all ingredients. Requires Intellectual 5. Intellectual alone reduces preparation from 90 minutes at 5 to 70 at 10 and 30 at 20. Operator failure interpolates from 30% at Intellectual 5 to 5% at 10, then 0% at 20. Indoor dirt adds up to 15 percentage points at cleanliness -2; sterile rooms give no bonus. Outdoor or unroofed exposure instead adds 10 points. Risk is captured at batch start and rolled once at completion. Automated processing defaults to 360 minutes (6 hours), reduced by 20 minutes per available gene processor to a minimum of 60 minutes (1 hour), reached with 15 processors. Power loss pauses processing and spoils a batch after two continuous hours. Do X times counts batches started; Do until X targets stored output.
